AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
MINUTES
June 10, 2009
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California
ROLL CALL
Members present:
Commissioner Rosales, Commissioner Rentschler, Commissioner Dodson, and Commissioner Alva.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
MINUTES
April 15, 2009
4-15-09action- minutes
Mr. Conal McNamara, requested minutes to be continued to the next mtg, in order to personally go through the tapes to make sure the changes made by the Commisssion are incorporated into the resolution.
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
Art Morales, spoke.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
1.
Continued from May 13, 2009 Case No.: Art in Public Places Ordinance
Applicant: City of Azusa
Location: Citywide
Request for consideration of a Public Art Ordinance applicable to new development and a recommendation to the City Council.
F-1 Public Art Reso
F-1 Valuation Estimate
F-1Public Art Policy Manual
F-1StaffRepot
Mr. McNamara presented staff report with changes by requests of Planning Commission.
Art Morales spoke.
Commissioners discussed the changes.
Commissioner Rentschler moved to approve 1. Continued from May 13, 2009 Case No.: Art in Public Places Ordinance
Applicant: City of Azusa
Location: Citywide
Request for consideration of a Public Art Ordinance applicable to new development and a recommendation to the City Council. , and second by Commissioner Alva.
The vote was as follows:
AYES:
Commissioner Rentschler, and Commissioner Alva.
NOES:
Commissioner Rosales, and Commissioner Dodson.
The vote was 2 - 2.
Mr. McNamara stated the Planning Commission Ordinance recommendation would move forward to City Council.
Commissioner Rosales stated he has no issue with the Ordinance but due to the state of the economy, he believes it is not the right time to enact such an Ordinance, maybe later.
Attorney Richardson stated the motion failed for the Public Art Program only. Motion must be reworded to reflect recommendation with stipulations to City Council from the Planning Commission.
Commissioner Dodson moved to approve 1. Continued from May 13, 2009 Case No.: Art in Public Places Ordinance
Applicant: City of Azusa
Location: Citywide
Request for consideration of a Public Art Ordinance applicable to new development and a recommendation to the City Council. , and second by Commissioner Alva.
The vote was as follows:
AYES:
Commissioner Rosales, Commissioner Rentschler, Commissioner Dodson, and Commissioner Alva.
NOES:
None.
The vote was 4 - 0.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
NEW BUSINESS
REPORTS AND COMMUNICATIONS
1.
Annual Review of the Rosedale Development Agreement.
I-1 Report
Roy Bruckner, project manager for Rosedale Development, gave staff presentation. This is the fifth review for the agreement reviewed on an annual basis. Developer has provided a compliance report which meets with the provision of development agreement which are being complied with and such compliance maintains the agreement in effect.
Mr. Robert Trapp, representative for Azusa Land partners spoke on the water reservoir facilities, they are working and operational pending only is the paper work on some reimbursements.
Mr. Trapp manages the project and all the aspects of the development agreement would apply to any other owner if there is a transfer of ownership.
Mr. Trapp stated the bank made a payment and only the agreement is before the Commission. He wishes the economic situation was different and hopes the bank would hire Azusa Land Partners to manage the project in the City of Azusa.
Mr. McNamara made a statement that the land plan with in the Development Agreement can not be changed unless it is brought to a vote before the Planning Commission.
Mr. Courtney, vicinty resident, spoke
Attorney Richardson reminded the Planning Commission that only the report was before the Commission, but update reports can be made to the Commission.
Commissioner Rentschler moved to approve 1. Continued from May 13, 2009 Case No.: Art in Public Places Ordinance
Applicant: City of Azusa
Location: Citywide
Request for consideration of a Public Art Ordinance applicable to new development and a recommendation to the City Council. moves forward to City , and second by Commissioner Alva.
The vote was as follows:
AYES:
Commissioner Alva, Commissioner Rentschler, and Commissioner Dodson.
NOES:
Commissioner Rosales.
The vote was 3 - 1.
2.
City Council Meetings Update.
Conal McNamara stated a Joint Meeting with City Council to be held June 29th, Housing Element would be discussed. Commissioner Dodson asked if this was a study session. Conal McNamara would be asking when and where is to be held and report to the Planning Commission.
DISCUSSION ITEMS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSIONERS
Commissioner Rentschler stated the water plant dedication was very informative good thing for the city.
Alva reported debris up by the water treatment plan; he believes it needs attention near Ranch Road.
Commissioner Dodson commented it was a beautiful facility and named appropriate after Joe Hsu.
Conal McNamara said there was an appeal filed to City Council on a Planning Commission decision on a Minor Use Permit for child daycare; tentatively to be on City Council Agenda for late July.
ADJOURNMENT UPCOMING MEETING:
Upcoming Planning Commission Meeting on June 29; a Joint Meeting between City Council and Planning Commission. The next Planning Commission Meeting was scheduled for July 15.
